# Q3 Update

Headline: revenue up 14 percent! Churn down for the third quarter running.

## Wins
- Closed the Northwind deal (largest this year)
- Launched self-serve onboarding; activation up 22 percent
- Cut support backlog from 340 to 90 tickets
- Hired the regional leads we planned for

## Risks
- Two enterprise renewals are open: decisions due in October
- Hiring in EMEA is behind plan
- Cloud spend is trending 8 percent over budget

## Decisions needed
1. Approve the EMEA hiring plan
2. Pick the pricing option: flat or usage-based?
3. Greenlight the data platform migration

## Next steps
- Finance to re-forecast cloud spend by Friday
- Sales to confirm both renewals this month
- Product to share the pricing analysis (one page)

## Metrics
- ARR: up, ahead of plan
- NPS: 51, steady
- Gross margin: 78 percent, flat
- Net retention: 112 percent!

## Customer notes
- Northwind wants a dedicated success manager
- Contoso asked for SSO; shipping in Q4
- Fabrikam is evaluating a competitor: executive call this week

## Asks
- Board: endorse the hiring plan
- Leadership: unblock the migration budget
- Everyone: keep the renewals on track

Overall: strong quarter. Focus for Q4 is retention, hiring, and cost control. Questions? Ask now!
